verdict.rationale: incident.io ships AI features such as Investigations, Suggestions, Scribe and AI postmortems, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack covers whether customer data is used for model training or offers a way to prevent it. The trust-and-safety page is about keeping investigation agents within the bounds you set, not about training data, so it does not count here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
